title: Early Reflex Smile
desc: Just one day old and already smiling — even if it was just a reflex, we chose to take it personally.
story: We know, we know — the books all say it's just a reflex. But the very next day after you were born, your little face broke into the tiniest, most fleeting smile while you slept. Mum and Dad looked at each other with absolute certainty: you were smiling at us. Science can say what it likes. We were keeping this one.
